title: Kay’s Nest – Design Stay Near Dining
description:
✨ Walk to Five Points and stay just minutes from Broadway at Kay's Nest. This brand-new 1-bedroom East Nashville apartment blends modern comfort with a prime location, making it perfect for couples, friends, business travelers, and extended stays. Enjoy thoughtfully designed living spaces and easy access to downtown, live music, local restaurants, coffee shops, and Nashville's top attractions. 🌆

The space
This one-bedroom, top-floor corner apartment features a bright and inviting living room. Fully equipped with everything you need to feel at home, it includes a modern, fully stocked kitchen, smart TVs in every room, and cozy beds. With all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay, it’s the perfect space to relax and unwind.

Things You'll Love: 
◆ Prime location in the heart of East Nashville (just 2 miles to Broadway)
◆ Cozy balcony with a sitting area
◆ Beautifully designed interior by a local designer
◆ Fully equipped kitchen,
◆ Smart TVs throughout—easily connect to all your favorite streaming apps!
◆ One off-street parking space
◆ Reliable high-speed Wi-Fi
◆ Private washer and dryer for added convenience
◆ Walking distance to Five Points with some of Nashville’s best restaurants
◆ Just one block from the famous Pharmacy Burger

Sleeping Arrangements:
◆ Bedroom: Queen Bed + Smart TV
◆ Full Bathroom with Walk-in Shower 
◆ Living Room: Full-size Sleeper Sofa + Smart TV

About Hallson Hospitality

At Hallson Hospitality, we take pride in being a locally owned company, offering a portfolio of thoughtfully designed properties that adhere to the highest standards of comfort and quality. Our team of hospitality professionals is dedicated to creating seamless and unforgettable experiences for each guest.

From curated amenities to personalized service, we go the extra mile to ensure your stay is exceptional. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your visit, please don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your time with us truly unforgettable. To further elevate your stay, we offer a variety of Experience Add-ons, including early check-ins and late check-outs, private chefs, in-home massages, in-home yoga sessions, and more.

Thank you for considering Kays Hideaway for your upcoming trip! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper right-hand corner, so it’s easy to find again – whether for this trip or a future stay.

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible.

Other things to note
The apartment is located on the second floor of the building, and please note, there is no elevator.

The parking lot is shared among all apartments and includes five standard parking spaces, along with one designated handicap space. Spaces are not assigned. Each reservation may park one vehicle in the lot, as availability allows. Additional street parking is available along Hart Avenue, just one block away.
